_note: The full DNS zone for truecombat.eu as Cloudflare should hold it. cf_setup.py makes Cloudflare match this list. proxied=true (orange cloud) only for the website itself; game, master (UDP), API, staff portal and mail stay DNS-only.

records.name: api
records.why: stats, launcher feed calls, game servers, EOS auth, Ko-fi webhook
Caddy certificates (Cloudflare adds its own CAs automatically)

_settings_why.ssl: Full (strict): Cloudflare talks to Caddy over HTTPS and checks its real certificate.
_settings_why.always_use_https: Caddy already redirects to HTTPS and sends HSTS; leaving this off lets Let's Encrypt HTTP challenges reach Caddy on port 80, so certificate renewals keep working behind the proxy.
_settings_why.email_obfuscation: It rewrites HTML and injects a script that the site's CSP blocks.
_settings_why.rocket_loader: Rewrites script tags; breaks the per-page CSP hashes.
_settings_why.browser_check: Can block the launcher and other non-browser clients that fetch launcher-feed.txt and account endpoints.
_settings_why.browser_cache_ttl: 0 = respect the Cache-Control headers Caddy sends.

http_request_cache_settings.description: Cache the whole website at the edge; the Cloudflare workflow purges on every site change
http_request_cache_settings.expression: (http.host eq "truecombat.eu" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/u/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/"))

http_ratelimit.description: Throttle floods on the account service (sign-in, linking and pairing codes)
